AIP Italian Burgers Recipe [Paleo, Keto]
By: Healing Autoimmune
Published: Monday, June 18, 2018 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




INGREDIENTS
1 lb of grass-fed ground beef (450 g)
2 Tablespoons of Italian seasoning (6 g)
2 Tablespoons of garlic powder (20 g)
1 Tablespoon of onion powder (7 g)

Preparation

1 INSTRUCTIONS 2 Mix all the ingredients together well and form burger patties from the mixture. 3 Grill or pan-fry in coconut oil until done to your liking.

About

DESCRIPTION: Grass-fed beef burgers are not only AIP, Paleo, and Keto, but they’re also just really tasty and easy to make.
